# Permissions and expiry

## The real decision ledger

**0 events. 0 compound events. EMPTY.**

No BBROSE asset has been activated as a canonical master. No palette has been approved.
No ownership has been confirmed, no licence approved, no permission granted — because no
authorised human has made those decisions yet. The machinery is ready; the decisions are
theirs.

## The permission set — derived, never hardcoded

9 flags, read from the canonical `PermissionSet` schema so
a report can never fall out of step with the code:

- `approved_for_bbrose`
- `approved_for_other_brands`
- `automatic_use_allowed`
- `embedding_allowed`
- `modification_allowed`
- `production_use_allowed`
- `public_export_allowed`
- `redistribution_allowed`
- `retrieval_allowed`

Granted **one at a time**, by name, by an authorised human. No implicit bundles.
Prerequisites are action-specific: internal retrieval needs no licence; production use
needs `LICENSE_APPROVED`; redistribution, public export and use for other brands are
`LEGAL_REVIEWER`'s alone.

## Media scope (new in v1.1.0)

Media is **independent of products**: products say what is being designed, media says
where it may be used.

- `ALL vs PRINT` → SCOPE_OVERLAPPING
- `PRINT vs PACKAGING_PRINT` → SCOPE_OVERLAPPING
- `DIGITAL vs SCREEN` → SCOPE_OVERLAPPING
- `PRINT vs DIGITAL` → SCOPE_DISJOINT
- `DIGITAL vs PACKAGING_PRINT` → SCOPE_DISJOINT
- `SCREEN vs WEB` → SCOPE_UNKNOWN_OVERLAP
- `WEB vs SOCIAL_MEDIA` → SCOPE_UNKNOWN_OVERLAP

A grant for `DIGITAL` covers `SCREEN` (the taxonomy says DIGITAL contains SCREEN) and
**denies** `PACKAGING_PRINT` (PRINT and DIGITAL are declared disjoint, and
PACKAGING_PRINT inherits it). `WEB` is **UNKNOWN** and therefore **denied** — an
undeclared relationship fails closed.

## Expiry fails closed

`effective_permissions()` returns `False` / `RE_REVIEW_REQUIRED` the instant the review
date passes — with or without an audit event. The grant event is never edited; only the
evaluation changes. Reading never writes.

## Colour comparison is gated

Naive CMYK→RGB comparison, ICC-less print comparison, Pantone names as identifiers, and
ΔE from uncontrolled previews are all **refused**. A ΔE built on a naive preview has
every trapping of a measurement and none of the validity.

`Pantone_3519C.ase` is **not** linked to Historical Design Memory.
